title: AgentSociety: Large-Scale Simulation of LLM-Driven Generative Agents Advances Understanding of Human Behaviors and Society
reasoning: The paper focuses on the architecture and performance of a large-scale social simulator (AgentSociety) and demonstrates its use in simulating social phenomena like polarization and economic policies. It does not contain a specific component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, moral reasoning frameworks, or ethics.
